newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ENDEMOL KEEPS LIPS SEALED ON BOURSE FLOAT DETAILS.
newsitem.headline: ENDEMOL KEEPS LIPS SEALED ON BOURSE FLOAT DETAILS.

text.p: TV production and live entertainment firm Endemol declined to give details of its upcoming stock market flotation at a news conference on Friday.
Executives of the company, briefing the press on 1995/96 results, said Endemol still plans to go ahead with the flotation before the end of this year but declined to indicate a date.

Joint chairman Joop van den Ende dismissed a report in Thursday's NRC Handelsblad newspaper saying that an equity stake of 30 percent would be offered to external investors. "That's not right," he told reporters.
Finance Manager Aat Schouwenaar said Endemol was still discussing the initial public offering with its financial advisors and therefore could not disclose details at this point.
However, he said that the offering would consist both of new shares and existing shares.
Most of Endemol's shares ae held by joint chairmen Joop van den Ende and John de Mol who merged their television production companies in 1994 to form Endemol.
